research.tip: Do a 5‑minute box‑breathing routine (inhale 4 s, hold 4 s, exhale 4 s, hold 4 s, repeat 4 cycles) before checking the results

data.title: Pay-Commission results dekh kar panic hota hai? Yeh dekho
data.title_en: Feeling panicked seeing Pay-Commission results? Watch this

scenes.text: Pay-Commission result dekh ke dil dhadak gaya!
scenes.text_en: Seeing the Pay-Commission result made my heart race!

scenes.text: Aap bhi final‑year engineering student ho, career news se stress hota hai? Par kya aapko pata hai is stress ka secret solution?
scenes.text_en: Are you a final‑year engineering student feeling stressed by career news? But do you know the secret solution to this stress?

scenes.text: Ek survey kehta hai ki major announcements ke baad grads mein anxiety spike ho jaati hai.
scenes.text_en: A survey says that anxiety spikes among grads after major announcements.

scenes.text: Ye us dost ko bhejo jo result screen open karne se darta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that friend who is afraid to open the result screen.

scenes.text: Acute stress se aap thode der ke liye focus lose kar sakte hain.
scenes.text_en: Acute stress can temporarily make you lose focus.

scenes.text: Lekin ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi, hamare paas ek simple tareeqa hai.
scenes.text_en: But there is no need to panic, we have a simple method.

scenes.text: Results padhne se pehle sirf paanch minute ka box breathing routine try karo.
scenes.text_en: Try just a five‑minute box breathing routine before reading results.

scenes.text: Inhale karo chaar seconds ke liye, phir hold karo chaar seconds.
scenes.text_en: Inhale for four seconds, then hold for four seconds.

scenes.text: Exhale karo chaar seconds, aur last mein phir se hold karo chaar seconds.
scenes.text_en: Exhale for four seconds, and finally hold again for four seconds.

scenes.text: Ye exercise aapke dimag ko shaant karti hai aur stress kam karti hai.
scenes.text_en: This exercise calms your mind and reduces stress.

scenes.text: Toh agle baar result kholne se pehle, yeh breathing zaroor try karna.
scenes.text_en: So next time before opening the result, definitely try this breathing.

data.description: A comforting and evidence‑based guide for fresh graduates dealing with Pay‑Commission anxiety, featuring a simple box‑breathing technique.
